# Apiyi.com Help & Documentation

> > Comprehensive guides and tutorials for integrating AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and other providers through the Apiyi.com API router service.

Apiyi.com is an AI API router platform that provides unified access to multiple AI models including GPT-4o, Claude 3.7, and image generation services. This help site offers integration guides, model comparisons, configuration tutorials, and troubleshooting resources for developers using AI APIs through Apiyi.com.

## Key Topics

- OpenAI GPT-4o and GPT-4.5
- Anthropic Claude 3.7 and Claude 3.5 Sonnet
- API integration and configuration
- Image generation (flux-kontext-pro, gpt-image-1)
- Open WebUI setup
- VSCode extensions (Roo Code, Cherry Studio)
- Streaming output configuration
- Model comparison and cost analysis
- Token limits and troubleshooting
- AI client applications (Chatbox, Cherry Studio)
- Video generation capabilities
- Dify workflow automation
- GLM-5 and Kimi K2.5 models

## API Integration Guides

- [Latest Integration Guides (June 2025)](https://help.apiyi.com/2025/06): Recent tutorials covering GPT-4o image generation, Apiyi.com integration workflows, and cost analysis for AI API usage
- [Advanced Integration Topics (June 2025 - Page 2)](https://help.apiyi.com/2025/06/page/2): Additional guides for GPT-4.1, Claude 4, and Dify workflow automation through Apiyi.com
- [AI API Router Services Overview](https://help.apiyi.com/ar): Comprehensive overview of AI API router services including GLM-5, Kimi K2.5, and OpenCode GO integration guides

## Model Setup & Configuration

- [February 2025 Updates](https://help.apiyi.com/2025/02): Setup guides for OpenAI GPT-4.5, Claude 3.7, and Open WebUI integration with Apiyi.com API router
